parsed.text: Current distributions (view=current) in both panels p0 and p1 at nodes n0–n3 are uniform 4×4 for both red and blue (all 16 cells tied as peaks). Copied prior or completed records noted in origins are not new estimates. Conditional candidate records (view=candidate) mostly reproduce the uniform peaks, but node n2 differs under some commands: for command k0 in both panels, blue peaks are the four cells in columns 2–3 of rows 0–1 and red peaks are the four cells in columns 0–1 of rows 0–1. For command k1 in both panels, node n2 shows a concentrated blue peak at cell [0,2] and a concentrated red peak at cell [0,1]. Command k2 candidate records at node n2 return to the uniform peak set. Conditional records are supplied estimates, not executed events.
